import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

class TestPatientAppointment(unittest.TestCase):
    @patch('module.PatientAppointment')
    def test_patient_appointment_creation(self, mock_patient_appointment):
        # Precondition
        mock_patient_appointment.return_value = MagicMock()
        
        # Input
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment()
